purpose: Freeze exactly one source-parity hypothesis for later implementation and raw-only qualification after the sealed Phase100 LAX-T accuracy regression. This record is not solver, raw, truth, accuracy, release, or Kaggle authorization.

scope.accuracy_evidence: sealed Phase82 and Phase100 aggregate/route metadata only
future_input_exclusions: truth or evaluator data in solver process

exactly_one_candidate.selector_off_contract: legacy/default behavior is unchanged bit-for-bit at the graph/config boundary
exactly_one_candidate.hypothesis: The official per-epoch seven-component C/ISB state and its vector CCDD coupling are a missing source contract in native scalar-c plus global-ISB construction; preserving that topology may remove the LAX-T source-parity regression.
not_a_claim: not proven to be the sole cause of the Phase82-to-Phase100 LAX-T change
not a claim that the candidate converges or improves accuracy
not a claim that official MATLAB uses a graph f state
not a solver or rank guarantee

clock_components.indices_1_to_6: official system/frequency clock/ISB component slots selected by sysfreq2sigtype.m
clock_components.fallback_code_7: sentinel for other/unsupported signal in sysfreq2sigtype.m; not an additional asserted C component

official.frequency_loop: f is only the MATLAB loop variable over FTYPE=[L1,L5]; it is not a graph state

native_current_to_replace_only_when_sele.position_key: x_i or Pose3 position slot per epoch
native_current_to_replace_only_when_sele.isb_key: global/time-invariant i per non-GPS clock group
native_current_to_replace_only_when_sele.optional_f_key: static secondary-signal code-bias f state; remains disabled and is not part of this candidate

candidate_representation.initial_D: exact retained EpochSeed.receiver_clock_drift_mps; no raw/zero/WLS/interpolated fallback
candidate_representation.optimized_result_surface: expose optimized per-epoch C components and D in FGOResult in retained source-key order

equation_and_factor_invariants.pseudorange: Use the official per-epoch C selector: base component C[0] plus the mapped system/frequency component; no base correction or PDC input.

clock_ccdd.component_behavior: D term is applied to C component 0 exactly as the official factor; vector C residual/Jacobian is retained for all components
clock_ccdd.sigma: official ordinary clock sigma 0.1 m and existing source vector noise construction; no new or tuned sigma

equation_and_factor_invariants.doppler: Keep existing raw corrected undifferenced Doppler v/D factors, filters, robust loss, and D units unchanged.
equation_and_factor_invariants.carrier_and_tdcp: Do not enable or alter carrier/TDCP factors in this candidate.
equation_and_factor_invariants.imu: Keep existing Pose3/velocity/CombinedImuFactor, axis/mounting, gravity, preintegration covariance, bias random walk, and attitude/velocity initialization unchanged.
equation_and_factor_invariants.priors: Preserve official vector-C initial-prior intent and all current configured priors; do not add a new gauge, anchor, or regularizer.
equation_and_factor_invariants.solver: Keep the already selected Phase100 main MULTIFRONTAL_QR branch and GNSS-first Cholesky branch unchanged; this candidate is not a solver experiment.
equation_and_factor_invariants.lm: No change to lambda schedule, damping, ordering, tolerances, maximum iterations, acceptance, or terminal branches.
equation_and_factor_invariants.noise_and_filter: No change to SNR/elevation/residual filters, measurement sigmas, Huber/robust-loss settings, or epoch retention.

handoff_contract.staging: GNSS-first solves raw-only C/D and position/velocity in memory, then main receives the same-run optimized C and D plus existing position/velocity.
handoff_contract.alignment_key: exact retained EpochSeed source index and UTC key; vector index is not accepted as a substitute for key equality
required_predicates: retained epoch key set is nonempty and duplicate-free
C and D vectors are full-length, finite, and exactly key-aligned in GNSS-first and main problems
GNSS-first accepted iterations are greater than zero and final cost is strictly below initial cost
no missing, short, reordered, nonfinite, raw, zero, WLS, or interpolated fallback
main structural output remains finite, Earth-valid, and exact expected-epoch coverage
failure is fail-closed with no fallback or solution publication
handoff_contract.output_policy: A later diagnostic or structural run must not publish solution rows; accuracy requires a new isolated evaluator contract.

rejected.reason: strong historical relevance but forbidden by raw-only/no-base boundary
official f is only a frequency-loop variable; enabling native f changes secondary observation population and is not source-faithful

read_policy.note: Only official source text and sealed Phase82/Phase100 aggregate metadata were inspected; official source load() statements were not executed and no MAT payload was opened.

next_boundary.implementation_scope: only the frozen selector-on per-epoch C/ISB state representation and required FGOResult/handoff plumbing
qualification_required: focused synthetic and legacy regression tests
source/diff audit proving solver, factor, unit, sigma, filter, LM, and default invariants
independent one-shot raw authorization before any raw run
